citations.anchor: rejects %s defaults
citations.why: A table-driven case asserts LocaleSet.fromDefs throws "Exactly one locale must set isDefault (got 0|2)" — zero and two defaults both fail at construction.

citations.anchor: rejects an empty set
citations.why: LocaleSet.fromDefs([]) must throw /at least one locale/ — pins the non-empty half.

citations.anchor: rejects a duplicate slug
citations.why: Two defs sharing slug 'en' must throw /Duplicate locale slug "en"/ — pins the uniqueness half, in the same constructor.

citations.anchor: rejects a %s slug
citations.why: Locale.create throws InvalidLocaleError for 'EN', 'en_us', '1en', 'abcd' and '' — the lowercase 2-3-letter primary tag rule; the 35-character cap is not exercised.

citations.anchor: returns a resolved dir for every configured locale
citations.why: Asserts each item of the locales list carries a dir even for locales whose config declares none — an undefined dir on the wire fails it.

citations.anchor: 400s a list scoped to an unknown locale
citations.why: ?locale=zz must answer 400; silently substituting the default would answer 200.

citations.anchor: an unconfigured ?locale= is reported
citations.why: Pins the client mirror: with ?locale=xx the switcher renders its unknown-locale state instead of claiming the default.

citations.anchor: lists only the default locale when no ?locale= is sent
citations.why: With a de row present, a list with no ?locale= must exclude it and every returned item must have locale 'en'.

citations.anchor: the default locale keeps a clean URL through the editor
citations.why: Pins the second clause — the admin must not spell ?locale=en; the URL assertions fail if toLocaleListParam wrote the default out.

citations.anchor: is [requested, default] when widening
citations.why: fallbackChain is asserted to be exactly two entries when widening, and the sibling cases pin the one-entry chains — a hierarchical chain would fail all three.

citations.anchor: ignores ?locale= on a non-localized type
citations.why: Creates and lists a non-localized type with ?locale=de and expects 201 + total 1 — a hook that did not check type.i18n would fail the create or filter the list. Only the create/list hooks are exercised; the write-sync hooks on a non-localized type are not asserted separately.

citations.anchor: 409s a duplicate locale in the group
citations.why: A second row for the same (group, locale) must answer 409 rather than landing.

citations.anchor: 404s a localeGroupId that names no group in the workspace
citations.why: A create naming an unknown group must 404 instead of creating a stray one-row group.

citations.anchor: gives a plain create its own fresh translation group
citations.why: Two ordinary creates must have different localeGroupIds — a shared or absent group id fails it.

citations.anchor: serializes two locales of one record instead of deadlocking
citations.why: The regression test for the lock-order inversion: 12 interleaved cross-locale saves of a shared field must all answer 200, which they did not before the group lock was taken first.

citations.anchor: leaves siblings alone when an array-valued shared field is resent unchanged
citations.why: Resending an identical jsonb array must leave the sibling's revision count unchanged — a comparison that saw the array as different would append a version.

citations.anchor: moves a rewritten published sibling back to draft, keeping publishedAt
citations.why: Asserts both halves: status becomes draft and publishedAt survives, which is what renders as Modified.

citations.anchor: 422s and rolls back when the sync would invalidate a published sibling
citations.why: A sync that would break a published sibling's rules must answer 422 and leave the source row unwritten.

citations.anchor: drops a mirrored link whose target is untranslated, and still saves
citations.why: Linking two authors where only one has a German row: the save succeeds and the German sibling links only the resolvable one, never the English row.

citations.anchor: gives a new translation the links the group already had
citations.why: A create body with no links must come back linked to the group's tag — the inward pull. The donor-selection rule (default locale, else lexicographically first) is not pinned by any test.

citations.anchor: appends a revision to each sibling the sync rewrote
citations.why: Each rewritten sibling must gain exactly one revision row from the same save — the pipeline half of the invariant.

citations.anchor: which negates inside the EXISTS (EC-26)
citations.why: hasLocale with ne and with nin must both answer 400 with a message naming hasLocale. The admin drawer's mirroring of the restriction is not pinned.

citations.anchor: reads missingLocale in [...] as missing ALL of them (EC-27)
citations.why: An entry missing only one of the listed locales must not match — the notExists-over-the-union reading rather than "at least one".

citations.anchor: counts only configured locales, so localeCount agrees with coverage (EC-25)
citations.why: With an unconfigured 'it' row in the group, localeCount eq 3 must match and eq 4 must not, while coverage reports the entry fully localized — exactly the drift the invariant forbids.

citations.anchor: counts records, not rows
citations.why: One record in three languages must report records: 1 — a count over rows would answer 3.

citations.anchor: reports the same figures per content type
citations.why: Pins the second clause: the per-type requiresLocalization figures are summed and asserted equal to the envelope's total.

citations.anchor: forces notLocalized to 0
citations.why: A dedicated app configured with one locale must report notLocalized 0 while records is non-zero.

citations.anchor: echoes back only the keys the caller supplied
citations.why: Asserts the response keys equal the three requested ids and that a foreign workspace's group and a nonexistent id both come back as [] — the seeding and the indistinguishability.

citations.anchor: refuses a type this workspace was not granted, without saying so
citations.why: The bulk-translate tool must reject an ungranted typeName with the same message a nonexistent type gets — the tool-side grant re-check. The "HTTP path does not" half is a negative and is not asserted.

citations.anchor: refuses a shared field, naming the ones that vary
citations.why: An item whose values name a shared field must be refused with a message listing the genuinely localized fields — the localized-fields-only half.

citations.anchor: writes every locale, carrying the shared values over
citations.why: Pins the applier half: the batch names only `text`, and each created sibling must still come back with the source's shared `select` — a create that stamped null would fail this and the source's own values are re-asserted afterwards.

citations.anchor: stops at the first failure and says how many landed
citations.why: A two-item batch whose second item fails must leave the first written, the second absent, and report "Translation 2 of 2 (fr) failed" / "The first 1 were saved" on the single proposal's error.

citations.anchor: a failed locale list leaves a retry in the toolbar, not a hole
citations.why: useLocales failing must draw the unavailable/retry control rather than removing the switcher — pins the useLocales clause.

citations.anchor: a failed group read says so instead of offering to create what exists
citations.why: useEntryLocales failing must show the widget error and "Unknown — couldn’t load" rows, and must offer neither a switch nor a create link — pins the useEntryLocales clause.

citations.anchor: a failed summary batch marks the Locales cells unavailable
citations.why: useLocaleSummaries failing must render "Unavailable" in the Locales cell rather than an empty cell that would read as "no other locales" — pins the useLocaleSummaries clause.

citations.anchor: the relation picker on a translation-create form is scoped to that locale
citations.why: On a /new?locale=de form the picker's candidate request must carry locale=de — an unscoped or default-scoped request never satisfies the waitForRequest. The applier's non-copying of per-locale relations is not pinned here.
